NOTES:

1. The financial results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at their meeting held on May 30, 2026.

2. Segment wise profitability and capital employed have not been disclosed, as the Infrastructure is common to all revenue generating activities of the Company, making it impracticable to allocate costs and assets on a segmental basis.

3. Pursuant to the impairment assessment carried during the year in accordance with the applicable provisions of Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS), the Company has recognised an impairment loss of Rs.1787.54 Lakhs in respect of goodwill arised during acquisition of its subsidiaries, Jade Resorts Private Limited and J.J. Arts & Entertainment Private Limited.

4. The Figures for the quarters ended March 31, 2026 and March 31, 2025 represent the balancing figures between the audited results for the full financial year and the un-audited year-to-date figures up to the third quarter of the respective financial years.

5. Figures for the previous periods have been regrouped / reclassified wherever necessary.
